name: Drua Sailing Experience
subtitle: Serviceable 24 V solar workshop with a permanently paralleled two-string bank

currency.note: Planning rate retained from the source workbook; use the actual purchase-date rate.

budget.note: Panels, batteries and the UniFi Express are included in the project total even though they have already been purchased. The estimated $607.11 Ekrano GX increment, net of the $80 list-price saving from using a non-GX rather than GX 24 V MultiPlus and including the estimated border-tax effect, is donor-funded. Both lights are now the same affordable 3000 K Amazon utility fixture; use 316 stainless replacement fasteners and seal the exterior unit under an eave because the budget product is not a Hella-grade salt-spray fixture. The Orion converter has been removed: UniFi, USB charging and lights all accept a nominal 24 V input. Victron power-electronics costs are current planning prices pending a same-part-number Solar Fiji quote. Freight beyond Nadi, panel mounting, Starlink hardware and labor are excluded.

summary: Four 565 W panels form two matched two-panel series strings (2S2P) and feed a Victron SmartSolar 150/85 through two separate 4 mm² positive/negative home runs. At the assumed 15 m one-way distance, the two runs lose about 2.0% at rated power and land directly in one indoor PV entry enclosure with two string-pair inputs and one combined output pair, a two-pole disconnect and surge protection. Four 12 V GEL batteries form two independently Class-T-protected 24 V series strings that are permanently paralleled through equal-length cables. A single Blue Sea 6006 disconnect switches the complete bank ON or OFF; it cannot leave one string unintentionally idle. A non-GX Victron MultiPlus-II provides AC and generator charging, while the Ekrano GX coordinates charge current, local monitoring and VRM reporting. The SmartSolar output and every service positive use resettable, 10 kA-interrupt-rated MidNite Solar DC breakers. The only remaining fuses are the two battery Class T devices and Victron's factory-supplied 3.15 A Ekrano lead. The Class T links are retained because the selected 150 A coordination has no exact resettable equivalent: common marine breakers have much lower interrupt ratings, while MidNite's high-interrupt battery breakers jump from 125 A to 175 A. Starlink uses its single OEM 15 m white DC lead. UniFi, a six-port Scanstrut USB-C/A charging panel and two identical warm-white utility lights use protected nominal-24 V branches. Three sealed rockers on the junction-box exterior provide one master INTERNET control plus independent INSIDE and OUTSIDE light controls.

powerModel.assumptions: 4.2 peak-sun-hours, 75% solar derate, 50% GEL depth of discharge, one power tool at a time, about 0.10 kWh/day for the always-on Ekrano GX with its display normally asleep, and 15 m one-way copper PV runs. PV cable loss uses 0.01724 Ω·mm²/m copper resistivity at 20°C; field temperature raises resistance, so confirm the actual route and cable before purchase.

batteryCablePlan.conductor: 1/0 AWG (53.5 mm²) UL 1426 flexible tinned-copper marine battery cable
batteryCablePlan.procurement: Import factory-crimped, adhesive-heat-shrunk assemblies; no heavy-cable crimper is required on site.
batteryCablePlan.measurementRule: Buy only after a 1:1 component layout. Measure hole-to-hole along the supported route, preserve broad bend radii, and keep the paired A/B paths equal. Confirm every stud before ordering, especially the purchased EverExceed battery terminals and final busbars.

components.kicker: Single indoor building-entry unit · PV-rated DC
components.summary: Both complete string pairs enter one indoor enclosure, where protected terminals parallel them ahead of surge protection and a common disconnect.

Type 2 PV SPD coordinated with 150 V MPPT

components.note: With only two parallel strings, a faulted string can receive about one intact-string Isc (14.20 A), below Suntech's 25 A maximum series-fuse rating, so this base design does not add an outdoor string-fuse/combiner box. Confirm the exact module label, cable ampacity, connector ratings and applicable Fiji/AS-NZS requirements before omitting string fuses. Each string can sit near 105 VDC in cool sunlight: cover modules before connector work and never break MC4 connectors under load.

components.title: SmartSolar MPPT 150/85-Tr
components.summary: A separate Victron charger keeps solar charging and essential DC services independent of the AC inverter/charger.
specs: 150 V absolute maximum PV Voc · 145 V operating maximum
2,400 W nominal PV capacity at 24 V
components.note: The 2S strings model at 104.7 V cold Voc, leaving about 40 V below the 145 V operating ceiling. Fit the matching WireBox-XL Tr, mount terminals down within 3 m of the battery bus, and use a MidNite Solar MNEDC100 100 A / 150 VDC / 10 kA AIC resettable output breaker with 10 cm ventilation clearance. Set the charger itself to 85 A maximum and let Ekrano DVCC cap the combined system charge current. Its VE.Can, remote on/off and programmable-relay interfaces remain available but unused in the base design.

components.title: MultiPlus-II 24/3000
components.summary: The non-GX model provides the same inverter, generator charger and transfer-switch capability while leaving the Ekrano GX as the system's single monitoring and control device.
specs: Supplied isolated temperature sensor to battery negative
components.note: Do not substitute the MultiPlus-II GX version when installing the Ekrano. IP22 and 95% non-condensing are not salt-spray ratings: mount in the dry, ventilated inner room behind the drip/salt shield, away from sea-facing openings and batteries. AC-out-2, remote on/off, programmable relay, auxiliary inputs, direct voltage-sense input and external-current-sensor input remain available but unused in this base design.

components.title: Ekrano GX
components.summary: The system's only GX device combines a bright local touchscreen with coordinated DVCC control, collects inverter, solar and battery data, and sends monitoring and alarms to Victron VRM through the UniFi Express and Starlink.
specs: 2 digital inputs used by balancer alarms
DVCC · SVS/SCS from SmartShunt · STS from MultiPlus sensor
Front IP54 with steel bracket · rear IP21
components.note: Power directly from the protected 24 V bus on the system side of the SmartShunt—not from AC output or the low-voltage-controlled load branch—so it can report faults and recovery. Mount horizontally on the wall immediately above the junction box with the supplied steel bracket, sheltered from drips and salt air, and route all small leads around rather than across its front. Hardwire Ethernet to the UniFi LAN port. A separate Smart Battery Sense is intentionally omitted: Ekrano distributes the SmartShunt's measured battery voltage and current and the MultiPlus sensor's battery temperature to the SmartSolar through DVCC. The two native temperature inputs and two relays remain available for future sensors or an alarm buzzer.

components.title: 24 V · 400 Ah GEL bank
components.summary: 9.6 kWh nominal, operated to about 50% depth of discharge for longer GEL life.
specs: One string: 4.8 kWh nominal · 2.4 kWh usable
components.note: Fully charge and voltage-match all four units separately before assembly. Use equal-length positive and negative string leads. Both strings remain connected in normal service so both are charged and discharged together. A faulted string is removed only during a full shutdown, after meter diagnosis, by disconnecting and insulating both of that string's leads.

components.title: Main DC distribution

Nothing else connects on the BATTERY MINUS side. Land the SmartShunt's supplied fused Vbatt+ sense lead on the fourth small positive-bus terminal. The positive 2104 then uses three large studs and all four small terminals, leaving one large stud spare; the negative 2104 uses three of each size, leaving one of each spare. Import all heavy 1/0 AWG assemblies preterminated after a 1:1 layout.

components.title: Main positive bus

components.title: Victron SmartShunt 500 A
components.summary: Both battery-string negatives land on BATTERY MINUS; one short 1/0 AWG link from SYSTEM MINUS feeds the negative bus, so every charging and load ampere is measured.
components.note: Nothing except the two battery-string negatives connects on the BATTERY MINUS side. All chargers, loads and chassis-related DC returns connect on the SYSTEM MINUS side through the negative bus.

components.title: Main negative bus
components.kicker: Blue Sea 2104 · system side of SmartShunt
components.summary: This covered bus collects every charger and load return after current has crossed the SmartShunt.
components.note: The only connection from this bus toward the batteries is the short SYSTEM MINUS link through the SmartShunt. Never bypass the shunt with a direct battery-negative return.

components.title: Master battery disconnect
components.kicker: Whole bank ON / OFF · marine grade
components.summary: A compact Blue Sea 6006 switches the complete permanently paralleled bank together; there is no setting that can strand one string at a different state of charge.
specs: 300 A continuous · 500 A for 5 min · 900 A for 30 s
components.note: Mount through a fixed internal faceplate—not the hinged door—so the heavy 1/0 AWG cables never flex when the box opens. Stack the two identical Class-T-protected positive string lugs on the input stud only after confirming lug thickness, stud engagement and the manufacturer's torque. Stop AC loads and all charging before switching OFF. A faulted string is isolated during a full shutdown with a multimeter and insulated tools; the switch never selects one string.

Alarm relay from each unit to one Ekrano digital input

AC input-current limit commissioned to the generator, plug and cable rating

Verify the actual generator before buying the plug. Never make a male-to-male lead. The generator's own breaker may provide input-cable protection only when its rating does not exceed the selected cable and plug ampacity.

components.title: AC output protection
components.summary: Small plywood-mounted enclosure with a two-pole 10 A / 30 mA Type A RCBO feeding one flexible tool lead; no receptacle is fixed to the building wall.
specs: MultiPlus AC-out L / N / PE hardwired

components.title: Trailing tool lead
components.kicker: 5 m Type I workshop lead · one tool
components.summary: One locally purchased Australian/Fiji Type I workshop extension lead becomes the movable tool outlet, avoiding any receptacle fixed to metal or thatched walls.

components.title: 24 V breaker distribution
components.summary: Seven resettable MidNite Solar breakers protect the SmartSolar output and every low-current positive circuit; black load conductors return unswitched and unbroken to a separate negative bus.
specs: Six-breaker service bank · 3 inputs / 6 protected outputs
Blue Sea 2314 return bus · 6 used landings + 1 spare
components.note: The six-breaker service bank correctly has three incoming positive conductors and six outgoing protected conductors. The 20 A service feeder and 5 A Starlink breaker each have an independent input and output; one short common-input comb then supplies the four adjacent UniFi, USB, inside-light and outside-light breakers. This is why the top and bottom connection counts do not match one-for-one. Only positive conductors pass through breakers and switches. The main-negative feeder, UniFi, USB, both lights and the tiny switch-indicator return use six of the seven landing positions on the covered Blue Sea 2314 MiniBus, leaving one spare. Starlink returns directly to the main negative bus. Each low-current positive/negative pair shares one gland and separates only inside the box.

components.title: SmartSolar 100 A DC breaker
components.summary: The dedicated high-interrupt breaker protects and isolates the SmartSolar battery-positive conductor between the main positive bus and MPPT gland.
components.note: This is the large MPPT branch breaker shown separately from the six-breaker low-current service bank. Its two selectable cylindrical ports are the positive-bus input and SmartSolar output.

components.title: Ekrano GX 3.15 A fuse
components.summary: The small inline holder protects the always-on Ekrano GX positive supply so monitoring remains available while other loads are switched off.
specs: Supplied or specified with Ekrano GX power lead
Individually selectable input and output ports
components.note: This remains a fuse because it is part of Victron's specified low-current equipment lead; carry labeled spares with the system.

Short high-quality USB-A to USB-C lead
components.note: Bench-test cold boot and repeated power cycling with the exact UniFi Express before travel; USB-A current advertisement varies between chargers even when the headline amperage is sufficient.

components.title: USB charging station

Each light has one source-side positive switch and one two-core run to its fixture; there is no separate switch cable along the building. All load negatives bypass the rockers.

Two independent 15 m one-way string home runs, each with a positive and negative conductor (4 conductors × 15 m = 60 m single-core total). Planning set: 2 × 12 in M8–M8 series links; 2 × 12 in assumed M8–M6 battery-to-Class-T; 2 × 36 in M6–M10 Class-T-to-master-disconnect; 2 × 36 in assumed M8–M10 battery-negative-to-SmartShunt; 1 × 12 in M10–M10 shunt-to-bus; 1 × 12 in M10–M10 disconnect-to-bus; 2 × 36 in M10–M8 buses-to-MultiPlus. The two equal positive string leads stack on the Blue Sea 6006 input stud; the two equal negative leads stack on SmartShunt BATTERY MINUS. Earth electrode/conductor allowance, frame and chassis bonds, lugs and corrosion protection.

Exact PMP242305010: 3 kVA inverter/charger with 2.4 kW output at 25°C, 2.2 kW at 40°C, 5.5 kW peak and 70 A charger. The non-GX model is intentional because the Ekrano is the system's one GX controller; do not substitute a 48 V, GX or 120 V model. Includes the battery-temperature sensor. Price is Victron's 2026 Q2 USD list price; request this exact part from Solar Fiji before importing. IP22/non-condensing still requires the protected indoor salt-air installation shown in the design.

Donor-funded all-in-one GX controller and 7-inch local touchscreen. Current Blue Marine listing shows 19 in stock with free US shipping. It provides VE.Bus, three isolated VE.Direct ports, hardwired Ethernet/VRM, DVCC coordination and local control. Mount horizontally with the included rear steel bracket for an IP54 front; protect its IP21 rear in the dry alcove. Confirm delivery before the 29 Aug departure.

SCC115085411 dedicated 85 A solar charger. Each 2S string is 104.7 V modeled cold Voc against the controller's 150 V absolute / 145 V operating limits; the combined 28.4 A array Isc is below its 70 A maximum, and 2.26 kW is within its 2.4 kW nominal 24 V PV rating. Use a 100 A protected battery branch. Price is Victron's 2026 Q2 USD list price; request the same part number in the Solar Fiji quote.

Manufacturer terminal cover SCC950400210 sized for the 150/85-Tr. It reduces accidental contact, insects and direct salt/dust deposition at the IP22 connection area; it does not make the controller weatherproof.

Planning allowance for combined 230 V Victron electronics and monitoring shipments to LAX; the current Ekrano listing includes US shipping, but replace this allowance with checkout quotes before ordering.
One balancer per independent two-battery 24 V string, with each alarm relay wired to a separate Ekrano digital input.

Whole-bank state of charge, current and voltage for Ekrano/VRM and DVCC Shared Voltage/Current Sense. Install the supplied 1 A fused Vbatt+ lead on the protected positive bus. Leave the Aux input reserved: one Aux channel cannot independently monitor both 24 V strings, so the two balancer alarm relays provide string-specific warning instead.

bom.item: Two-string 150 A Class T fuse package
bom.description: Two high-interrupt-rated covered holders mounted close to the two string positives, two installed Blue Sea 5114 150 A fuses and at least one spare. Class T is retained deliberately: its 20,000 A interrupt rating is appropriate for a battery short, while common resettable marine breakers have much lower interrupt ratings. MidNite's high-interrupt battery-breaker range offers 125 A and 175 A rather than an exact 150 A replacement; 125 A risks compromising MultiPlus surge headroom and 175 A changes the selected cable/protection coordination. These are the only user-service fuse links other than Victron-mandated small inline fuses.

Compact IP66 marine ON / OFF switch for the complete permanently paralleled bank, 300 A continuous and 48 VDC maximum. Two equal Class-T-protected string-positive lugs share its input stud; its output feeds the main positive bus. It cannot accidentally leave one string idle. Amazon ASIN B00445KFZ2.

bom.item: Indoor two-string PV entry protection, combine + Type 2 SPD
bom.description: One building-entry enclosure with four labeled string-conductor inputs, protected parallel terminals, a 40 A two-pole PV disconnect and Type 2 PV SPD coordinated with the 150 V MPPT. No separate outdoor array fuse/combiner is included: with two strings, reverse current from the one intact string is about 14.20 A, below the module's 25 A maximum series-fuse rating. Final component selection, cable/connector ampacity, ambient derating and local-code review require installer verification.

Resettable, non-polarized, listed 150 VDC breakers with 10,000 A interrupt rating: MNEDC100 for SmartSolar output; MNEPV20 service feeder; MNEPV5 Starlink; MNEPV2 UniFi; MNEPV15 USB station; 2 × MNEPV1 lights; plus one spare MNEPV5. The 13 mm branch breakers mount on DIN rail in the junction box. Amazon does not reliably stock every exact amperage, so the primary link is the manufacturer listing; do not substitute unbranded automotive breakers.

bom.item: Scanstrut SC-TILE-20 dual USB-C charging module
bom.description: One dual-USB-C module for the shared six-port station. It accepts 10–32 VDC and can provide up to 60 W at 24 V. Install beside the two SC-TILE-10 modules in one small indoor faceplate/back box; feed the station through one unswitched 15 A pair and protect each module locally with a resettable 10 A breaker. No cigarette-lighter socket.

bom.item: Scanstrut SC-TILE-10 USB-C + USB-A charging module
bom.description: Two mixed-port modules complete the station. Together with the SC-TILE-20 they provide 4 × USB-C PD and 2 × USB-A ports. Each accepts 10–32 VDC and can provide up to 60 W at 24 V; protect each locally with a resettable 10 A breaker inside the small wall charging panel.

bom.item: Powerwerx USBbuddy2 dedicated UniFi converter + short USB cable
bom.description: Potted 8–35 VDC to 5 V / 3 A converter on the 2 A resettable-breaker nominal-24 V INTERNET pole-B branch, plus a short high-quality USB-A-to-USB-C lead. Bench-test cold boot and repeated switching with the exact purchased UniFi Express before travel.

Already purchased. Starlink Ethernet connects directly to its WAN port; it supplies the cloud gateway, UniFi Network application and Wi-Fi 6 without another router or access point. Planning value shown until replaced by the receipt.

bom.item: 2 × Blue Sea 2104 600 A main busbars + covers
bom.description: Two Blue Sea 2104 PowerBars plus two 2708 covers. Each 600 A / 48 VDC bar has four 3/8 in studs and four #8 screw terminals. The positive bar has seven conductors: three heavy circuits on individual studs and four light circuits—including the SmartShunt's supplied fused Vbatt+ lead—on all four screws, leaving one large stud spare. The negative bar has six conductors: three heavy and three light, leaving one stud and one screw spare. Amazon ASIN B000XBB758 for the busbar; covers are Blue Sea 2708.

bom.item: Blue Sea 2314 covered 100 A service-return bus
bom.description: Six landing positions are used: main negative feeder, UniFi, USB station, inside light, outside light and switch-indicator return. Starlink has its own landing on the main negative bus. The covered 2314 provides two studs plus five screw terminals—seven positions total—leaving one spare, with no load-current conductor switched or breakered on the negative side. Amazon ASIN B000OTJ89Q.

bom.item: Blue Sea 2128 250 A earth/bonding bus + 2719 cover
bom.description: Six actual bonds: earth electrode, PV entry/array frame, SmartSolar chassis, MultiPlus chassis, AC protection PE and Ekrano chassis. The 2128 has two 5/16 in studs for the large electrode lead plus six #10 screws for equipment bonds, leaving one stud and one screw spare. Add the 2719 insulating cover. Amazon search is used because the direct US listing is seller-dependent.

bom.item: 3 × Blue Sea 2132 resettable 10 A USB-module breakers
bom.description: Three compact marine push-to-reset breakers replace the three local 10 A USB module fuses inside the charging-station back box. They are downstream of the junction's 15 A feeder breaker, so a failed module can be reset or isolated without opening the main junction box.

Two 0.9 m VE.Direct cables (SmartSolar and SmartShunt), one 3 m Victron RJ45 UTP cable (MultiPlus VE.Bus), and one short unshielded Ethernet patch lead (UniFi LAN). The Ekrano retains one spare native VE.Direct port; no VE.Direct-to-USB adapter is needed.

bom.item: Compact IP-rated junction box · about 14.6 × 10.4 × 5.9 in
bom.description: Target exterior envelope about 370 × 265 × 150 mm, only 20 × 18 mm larger than the PG enclosure, with a flat hinged door and removable backplate. The added area is required for a device-free bottom gland gutter, through-wall switch-body keep-outs and terminal-radius-aware spacing. The Ekrano mounts separately on the wall above the box; the whole-bank disconnect mounts on a fixed internal faceplate; the backplate carries SmartShunt, covered buses and resettable DC breakers. All 14 cable glands and the Starlink bulkhead jack are on the bottom. Make a full-size depth-and-bend-radius mock-up before ordering or drilling.

One spare 150 A Class T link, two spare 3.15 A Ekrano lead fuses, any Victron-required balancer sense fuses, MC4 pair, corrosion inhibitor, replacement filter media and printed breaker/wiring labels. No blade-fuse assortment is required.

One additional checked piece at the Fiji Airways published ‘from $100’ USA rate. The 19 kg MultiPlus plus an iM2875 shell would exceed 23 kg, so transport it in a lighter protected bag or purchase an overweight allowance. The imported 24 ft 1/0 AWG cable set adds about 4.6 kg / 10.2 lb; distribute it, the Ekrano, 4.5 kg MPPT and other electronics across remaining luggage, perform a complete packed weigh-in, and confirm the booking-specific fee and 158 cm limit.

Rounded-up allowance equal to approx. 12.5% of the current $3,955.80 imported-goods and inbound-supplier-freight estimate, including the preterminated battery-cable set. Professional/technical equipment and goods above the passenger allowance must be declared; seek any renewable-energy concession approval before travel.

The electrical design includes its load and one complete OEM 15 m two-conductor DC power cable from the junction bulkhead jack to the Mini, but the Starlink hardware and cable purchase are outside this project. Do not replace that exterior run with separate field-routed red and black conductors.
Separate cyclone-rated structure, rails and panel attachment are by others. Array-frame bonding remains in scope.

bom.item: Freight beyond Nadi / to the island
bom.description: Inter-island freight is expressly excluded.
Labor cost is excluded because it is donated. AC/RCD/earthing work and final tests still require a suitably qualified person.

operatingRules: Keep both PV strings on their separate 4 mm² positive/negative home runs all the way to the indoor entry enclosure. Do not combine at the array or substitute MC4 branch leads; this revision deliberately removes the one-run fallback and the outdoor combiner.

Use one corded power tool at a time from the dedicated trailing socket and keep the tool nameplate at or below about 1,800 W. Fully uncoil and inspect the lead before use; do not add a power board, daisy-chain another extension, or combine the saw with the planer, jigsaw, drill, kettle or another large AC load. Hang the lead dry beside the equipment after use.
Run tool work mainly in sunny hours. Stop tool loads around 50% state of charge; reserve the lower half of the GEL bank for longevity and essentials.

Keep the AC inverter off when no AC loads are required. Use the exterior INTERNET rocker to shut down both Starlink and UniFi overnight; general USB charging remains available. INSIDE and OUTSIDE rockers control their light branches independently.
Leave the Ekrano GX powered so it can retain battery history and report alarms. Let its display time out when not in use; investigate alarms locally before resetting them.
Leave the whole-bank disconnect ON in normal service. Switch it OFF only after AC loads, MultiPlus, PV and generator charging are shut down.

If a battery or balancer alarm suggests a bad string: shut down every load and charge source, switch the whole bank OFF, verify individual battery and string voltages with a multimeter, and disconnect and insulate both leads of the diagnosed bad string. Only then may the healthy string be reconnected and the master switch returned ON. Reduce the Ekrano DVCC charge-current limit from 100 A to 50 A and treat one-string service as essentials-only limp mode: no power tools until both strings are healthy.
Never equalize GEL batteries. Inspect individual battery voltage, temperature, swelling, torque and corrosion monthly.

Keep all power electronics dry and away from direct salt air. Every three months, isolate the system, inspect for salt deposits or corrosion, clean/replace the alcove filter and correct any moisture source.
Treat the generator as tested backup only. Confirm the MultiPlus accepts its voltage/frequency and verify RCD/earth behavior before relying on charging or bypass.
commissioning: Confirm all four panel and battery nameplates before terminating anything.

Before ordering the imported heavy-cable set, buy or fix the exact Class T holders, Blue Sea 6006 disconnect, SmartShunt and Blue Sea 2104 busbars; then make a full-size battery/box/MultiPlus layout from actual hardware and battery dimensions. Confirm the EverExceed terminal is M8, measure each supported route hole-to-hole, preserve broad bends, and keep the paired A/B positive and negative paths equal. Confirm that two finished M10 lugs fit the 6006 input stud with full nut engagement at specified torque. Order the 12 UL 1426 tinned-copper 1/0 AWG assemblies factory-crimped with tinned lugs and adhesive heat-shrink; no site crimping is planned.
Separately fully charge and voltage-match the four batteries. Build two matched 24 V strings, install one balancer per string, and land each balancer alarm relay on its own Ekrano digital input.

Fit a 150 A Class T fuse close to each string positive. Make both positive and negative string paths equal in conductor size and length, identify A and B permanently, and prove that the Blue Sea 6006 switches the complete parallel bank ON / OFF with all charge sources and loads disabled. There must be no one-string selector position.

With modules covered, build two independent two-panel series strings. Uncover and measure about 100.8 V Voc at 25°C on each string separately; confirm close agreement, polarity, labels and isolation before landing all four 4 mm² home-run conductors. Parallel them only at the protected indoor building-entry terminals, then confirm the SmartSolar's 100 A protected battery branch before closing the 40 A PV disconnect.

Before omitting individual string fuses, confirm the installed modules retain the published 25 A maximum series-fuse rating and 14.20 A Isc, verify each home-run cable and connector against the actual installation method and temperature, and have the final design checked against applicable Fiji/AS-NZS requirements. Record current from each string independently at commissioning.

Program MultiPlus and SmartSolar for the exact GEL label; planning values are 28.2 V absorption, 27.2 V float and equalization disabled. Install the temperature sensor supplied with the 24 V MultiPlus on Battery 1's negative terminal. In Ekrano DVCC, select the SmartShunt for Shared Voltage Sense and Shared Current Sense, select the MultiPlus sensor for Shared Temperature Sense, and set the system-wide charge-current limit to 100 A with both strings healthy. Do not add a Smart Battery Sense unless this wired sensing path is later removed or proves unusable.
Set the MultiPlus to 230 V / 50 Hz with a 10 A AC input-current limit for the G3200P; verify generator acceptance before enabling unattended charging.

With the 24 V bank isolated, make a full-size enclosure and wall-layout mock-up. Mount the Ekrano horizontally just above the approximately 14.6 × 10.4 inch junction box using its steel bracket, keep its rear and lower connectors sheltered, bond its protective-earth terminal and preserve clear service access around its face.

Power the Ekrano directly from the protected 24 V bus with its supplied 3.15 A slow-blow fused lead, with negative on the system side of the SmartShunt. Never power it from MultiPlus AC-out or from the voltage-controlled DC-load branch.

Connect the MultiPlus by Victron RJ45 UTP/VE.Bus, SmartSolar and SmartShunt by separate VE.Direct cables, both balancer alarm relays to separate Ekrano digital inputs, and Ekrano Ethernet to the UniFi Express LAN port. Confirm all three Victron devices, SmartShunt battery state, battery temperature, SVS/SCS/STS sources and both balancer alarms appear locally.

Register the Ekrano in VRM over UniFi/Starlink, enable HTTPS and two-factor authentication on administrator accounts, configure useful battery/temperature/offline alarms, set a connection-appropriate log interval, and test both local operation without internet and remote recovery after reconnect.
Set the Ekrano display auto-off timer and adaptive brightness, record the VRM Portal ID and access recovery details off-site, and export configuration backups before departure.
Torque to each manufacturer specification; re-torque after the first week and mark fasteners with witness paint.

Have a qualified electrical person test RCBO trip time, polarity, the continuous protective-earth path, lead strain relief, trailing-socket wiring and neutral-earth behavior in both inverter and generator/bypass modes. There are no fixed workshop wall outlets.

Cut the Blue Sea 8259 opening in the fixed junction-box sidewall only after a 1:1 fit check. Install the 8287 DPST rocker as INTERNET and two 8282 SPST rockers as INSIDE and OUTSIDE; add a continuous closed-cell perimeter gasket, seal every fastener, insulate the rear terminals and leave the hinged door free of control wiring.

Install the resettable DC breaker map exactly as documented: MNEDC100 SmartSolar, MNEPV20 service feeder, MNEPV5 Starlink, MNEPV2 UniFi, MNEPV15 USB panel and 2 × MNEPV1 lights. Feed Starlink from its 5 A breaker into INTERNET pole A and return it to the main negative bus; INTERNET pole B switches UniFi, and the two SPST rockers switch only their light positives. Land the UniFi, USB and two light negatives directly on the Blue Sea 2314 return bus. Bring each low-current positive/negative pair through one bottom gland and separate the conductors only inside the box. Daisy-chain the three rocker indicator negatives with small black wire to the sixth used return-bus position, leaving one position spare. Label both ends of every conductor and each breaker.

Connect Starlink Ethernet directly to the UniFi Express WAN port. Feed UniFi directly from the 24 V bank through the dedicated 8–35 V Powerwerx USBbuddy2 on INTERNET switch pole B, export a UniFi backup, and bench-test at least ten cold starts and simultaneous Starlink/UniFi shutdowns before travel. Confirm general USB charging stays live with INTERNET off.

Build the six-port charging station from one Scanstrut SC-TILE-20 and two SC-TILE-10 modules in one dry interior faceplate/back box. Feed one 15 A protected 24 V pair from the junction box, split it locally through three Blue Sea 2132 resettable 10 A module breakers, label the four USB-C and two USB-A ports, and load-test all modules simultaneously before travel.

Use QHLightlux B0F1V59NXC 3000 K fixtures for both locations. Suspend the indoor unit from a short dry bracket with its lens down; mount the outdoor unit under an eave with 316 stainless fasteners and sealed bedding. Put two 3 A silicon rectifier diodes in series with each switched positive branch so the fixture stays below its 28 V input ceiling during GEL absorption. Heat-shrink and support the diode packs, verify polarity and voltage drop, and use one site-measured two-core marine cable to each fixture.

Bench-test the Starlink Mini from the 24 V branch through its complete OEM 15 m cable: verify center-positive polarity at the bulkhead jack, cold-start it at low battery voltage, and confirm INTERNET simultaneously removes Starlink and UniFi 24 V feeds without interrupting USB or lights.

Run the 1,800 W saw alone for 30 minutes in warm conditions with the 5 m lead fully uncoiled while monitoring inverter, lead, plug/socket, cable and terminal temperature; post the one-page operating rules and breaker map beside the equipment.
